findings.title: Test has a race condition: reader thread is not joined before assertion
findings.body: After setting `deletedAll.set(true)`, the test immediately asserts that `caughtExceptions` is empty. However, the reader thread may still be in the middle of its last `groups()` call (it passed the `while (!deletedAll.get())` check before the flag was set). If that call throws, the exception is added to `caughtExceptions` after the assertion has already executed, making the test non-deterministic. The thread should be joined (e.g., store the Thread reference and call `thread.join()`) before asserting on `caughtExceptions`.

findings.title: Returning null from getSubGroupsCount() is inconsistent with the class's error-handling contract
findings.body: When the group is not found in the database (deleted concurrently), this fix returns `null` from `getSubGroupsCount()`. However, other methods in the same class (`getDelegateForUpdate()` at line 61 and `isUpdated()` at line 74) throw `IllegalStateException("Not found in database")` in the same situation. Returning null silently propagates a potentially unexpected value to callers (e.g., `GroupUtils.populateSubGroupCount` calls `representation.setSubGroupCount(group.getSubGroupsCount())`), which may cause NPEs or incorrect data downstream. A more consistent approach would be to throw the same `IllegalStateException` or handle the missing group at a higher level.

findings.title: Same potential NPE exists in getSubGroupsStream overloads that call modelSupplier.get() without null check
findings.body: Lines 256, 262, and 268 all call `modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...)` without a null check on the result of `modelSupplier.get()`. These have the same race condition that this PR fixes in `getSubGroupsCount()` — if the group is deleted concurrently, `modelSupplier.get()` returns null and a NullPointerException is thrown. The fix should be applied consistently to these methods as well.

findings.title: Test may not exercise the fixed code path
findings.body: The test calls `managedRealm.admin().groups().groups(null, 0, Integer.MAX_VALUE, true)` with `briefRepresentation=true`. The NPE fix is in `getSubGroupsCount()`, which is invoked via `GroupUtils.populateSubGroupCount` only when the `subGroupsCount` flag is true. If the brief representation path does not trigger `getSubGroupsCount()`, this test does not actually reproduce the original bug. The test should verify it exercises the specific code path that was fixed (e.g., by requesting full representation with subgroup counts, or by adding a comment explaining why brief=true is sufficient).
